editorial.blurb: Mica's serves authentic, lovingly made Mexican comfort food in a warm neighborhood spot where the tortas are fluffy, the pozole hits different, and the owner treats you like family.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the pozole on a cold Chicago day, and don't skip dessert—the flan and tres leches are worth every bite, especially shared among friends.

topDishes.note: Generous hunks of perfectly seasoned meat—the standout taco
Perfectly balanced, ideal for winter comfort
Fluffy, delicious bread with great-sized sandwich
